causes.what: Memory leak in the app process on app-03 (no alert on the leak itself): mem.util.pct climbed linearly from 55% at 06:02 to 96.5% at 07:01, after which the process was restarted or OOM-killed (mem dropped to 35% at 07:02). Since then memory refills at about 17% per minute, the job queue is saturated at 600 and response time is 5.3s. The other app host, app-01, is normal.

unrelated_alerts: web-02: Disk space is low on / (jumped from 40% to 91.5% at about 06:22 and has stayed flat since; separate from the app-03 fault, only 2.35% http 5xx on web-02)
evidence: app-03 mem.util.pct was flat at 55% until 06:01, then rose 0.7% per minute to 96.5% at 07:01; the High memory utilization alert fired at 06:53 and resolved at 07:02 only because of the drop.
At 07:02 mem fell to 35.1%, then went 52.1, 69.1, 86.1, then 35.1 and 52.1 again at 07:06-07:07. This repeated sawtooth, about 17% per minute, is the leak recurring after the restart.
app-03 app.queue.depth was normal at 20-60 until 07:02, then 343 at 07:03 and 600 (cap) from 07:04. app.resp.ms is 5346 versus 326 on app-01.

app-03 cpu is 23%, disk 40%, and db errors are 0, so this is not a resource shortage elsewhere. db-01 is healthy (cpu 25%, io wait 4%, replica lag 3.7s, slow queries 1.6 per second), so the database is not the cause.
app.version is constant at 412 on app-03 and app-01 across the last 90 minutes, so no deploy explains the onset; the leak started at 06:02 on app-03 only.
web-02 fs.root.pct went from 40% to 91.5% between 05:37 and 06:22, hours before the app-03 problem, and has been flat since.
